content: Yeisu tauyemidiwo vehabadi i'awanoi

Ginauli teina Yeisu bada i'ata'idi'o ta galewa ainai itamayahi, ta i'awa'awanoi, iwalo, ‘Tamagu, yagu hauga bada ibwalenima'o. Ainaena yau natum mata yam wasawasa umohegau ta yam wasawasa ya'abiye mahalava.
Dova owa loina umohegau tomowa maudoidi vehabadi, na ainaena yau yawahi miyamiya vateyaina tomowaowa yamohe geyo'awaei aidiyai.
Neta yawahi miyamiya vateyaina mata tomowa hihanapuigo ebeha owa ubom Yaubada moiha, yo yau Besibesinanagu hihanapuigau ebeha owa uvevetamalegaumane.
Bale'u teina ainai yam wasawasa ya'abiye mahalavaya'o, wuwuna yagu paihowao umomohegauwa bada yave'ovidi'o.
Tamagu ee, owa, teina hauga mehemwai u'abiye wasawasaegau, dova mugai owa na yau yada wasawasawa ainai tamiyamiya, na mulitai bale'u ta'a'atububunine.
‘Ta mumugam maudoina bada yave'itaena'o hiya taumiya bale'u umomohegaune aidiyai, wuwuna owa yam bodao na umomohegaune, ta yam walo maudoina himulitaedi,
yo hinage ginauli maudoina umomohegaune hihanapuidi'o ebeha owa alimwena hilalaomane.
Eeta walowa umomohegaune bada yave'itadi'o ta atediyai himwaudi'o, ainaena hihanapu ili'ilimanigau ebeha owa alimwena yalalaomane, yo hinage hiyemidiyegau ebeha owa uvetamalegaumane.
Ainaena teina hauga vehabadi ya'awa'awanoi alimwai. Nigele ebeha taumiya bale'u vehabadi, na hesi bodaone umomohegaune vehabadi, wuwuna hiya yam bodao.
Na yam bodaone yau yagu bodao dova hinage yagu bodaone owa yam bodao. Eeta yada bodaone yadi yemidi ainaena yavewasawasa'o.

Na yau hauga teina bale'u yalaugabaei na alimwai yalaowa, na hiya bale'uwai himiyamiya, vehabadi ya'awa'awanoi. Tamagu tauwahiyala yeham ala'alawowolina ainaena u'ita avivinidi na yeham umomohegauwa, ainaena hiyeboda ehebo, dova owa na yau tave'ehebone.
Haugana yau baidadi yam wahiyalane umohegau'o ainaena ya'i'ita avivinidine, ta nigele teya yayagabaei, na ehebo a'ava yababa ainaena mugai Buki Ve'ahihi ainai iwalo mahalava'o ta ebe i'wadalele.
‘Ta yau bada teina na yalalaowa alimwai, na yagu walo teina bale'uwai yagu bodao yawalowalowedine aidiyai ebe yagu yaliyaya ainaena hiyaliyaya mwala'ina.
Ta tomowadine yam walo bada yamohedi'o, na hesi taumiya bale'u hive'alehaedi, wuwuna hiya nigele taumiya bale'u yadi boda aidiyai hiyamiyamiya, dova hinage yau nigele yadi boda ainai yayamiyamiya.
Nigele yaya'awanoi vehabadi ta ebeha bale'uwena uvai mahalavaedi, na hesi ya'awa'awanoi vehabadi ta ebe havena Tomodulele i'abi'abitowoidi.
Ainaena teina hauga hiya nigele taumiya bale'u yadi boda ainai hiyamiyamiya, wuwuna hiya dova yau.
Ya'awanoi alimwai ta yam walo moihaena u'abiye ve'ahihiyedi ta ebe yam bodao masemaseledi.
Dova owa uvetamalegauma taumiya bale'u aidiyai yau hinage teina yavetamaledi taumiya bale'u aidiyai.
Yagu bodao vehabadi yatalamwegau alimwai ta ebe hauga ilalaoma ainai hiya hinage hitalam moiha alimwai.
‘Tamagu yo, nigele ebeha hibom vehabadi yaya'awanoi, na hesi hiya hinage mulitai yadi walowena hiyemidiyegau vehabadi.
Ya'awanoi alimwai ta ebe maudoidi hive'ehebo alidai, dova owa na yau ehebo ta'i, na ainaena taumiya bale'u hiyemidiyegau ebeha owa uvevetamalegaumane.
Mugai yam wasawasa umomohegauwa bada bodadine yamohedi'o, ta ainaena hive'ehebo'o, dova tabom yada ve'ehebone.

Ta yau aidiyai yamiyamiya, owa hinage aliguwai umiyamiya, ta teina ainaena hive'ehebo moiha. Ta teina ainaena taumiya bale'u hihanapuigau ebeha owa uvetamalegauma, yo hinage hihanapuigo ebeha owa hiya uvelauwedi, dova yau uvelauwegau.
‘Tamagu yo, hiya bada umohedi'o aliguwai nuwanuwagu na baidaguwao amiyamiya. Ta tenem ainaena yagu wasawasawa umomohegauwa hi'ita, wuwuna mulitai abo bale'u upaihowai owa uvelau mugaiyegau.
‘Tamagu yo, owa taudumwalu, na taumiya bale'u nigele hiyahanapuigo, na hesi yau yahanapuigo'o. Na hinage teina bodaone bada hihanapuigo'o ebeha owa uvetamalegaumane.

Eeta mumugam yave'itaena'o aidiyai, na howola abo yave'itauyoidi ta hihanapu ili'ilimanigo, na ainaena yam velaune ateguwai imiyamiya, hiya hinage atediyai imiyamiya, na yau hinage atediyai yamiyamiya.’
